name: Marion
source:
A proud young noblewoman who has shouldered great responsibility from a young age, Marion yearns for a taste of freedom. Instead, she finds herself escaping from an arranged marriage. Whether as a rebel in Sherwood Forest or a spy in Nottingham, can Marion take hold of the future she seeks? And will love find her when she least expects it?

Strengths: Intelligent, brave, capable, practical
Flaws: Stubborn, speaks before thinking, hot-tempered

Likes: Reading, swordplay, good conversation
Dislikes: Gardening, limiting social norms, being patronised

[From [url=https://velvet-cupcake-games.itch.io/made-marion]itch.io[/url]]
